provenance: Synthetic cases authored with AI assistance; not a blinded, independent or external benchmark.
protocol: Select the lexical coverage policy and threshold on validation-v1 only. Score answerability-holdout-v2 once after implementation is fixed, preserve all failures, and treat it as exposed thereafter.

policy.method: IDF-weighted fraction of distinct query terms present in the top document
policy.selection: Threshold selected on validation-v1 to retain all supported cases while reducing unsupported answers. The v2 holdout was frozen before scoring.

cases.query: Requests cancelled by the caller leave HikariPool connections checked out. Pending database requests grow while idle connections stay at zero.
cases.rationale: Connection return after cancellation is covered.

cases.query: Two reconciliation workers update the same tables in opposite order and deadlock. What evidence should we collect?
cases.rationale: The runbook covers update ordering and blocking sessions.

cases.query: One Kafka partition falls behind while the others keep up; event age rises and message processing on that partition is slow.
cases.rationale: Per-partition processing and lag are covered.

cases.query: After a consumer release, messages with the older schema fail serialization and keep cycling through the dead-letter queue.
cases.rationale: Schema contract and poison-message investigation are covered.

cases.query: New OpenShift replicas run without crashing but readiness probes use the old port after a rollout. How should we investigate?
cases.rationale: Probe path, port and startup timing are covered.

cases.query: JVM memory peaks during large batch processing and the container is OOMKilled, although steady-state usage is low.
cases.rationale: Batch peaks and container/JVM memory comparison are covered.

cases.query: A workflow worker completed a side effect but failed before acknowledging the task; the Camunda job now has exhausted retries.
cases.rationale: Side-effect completion and idempotent retry review are covered.

cases.query: An approval message uses a different name than the waiting process subscription and fails correlation.
cases.rationale: Message-name and correlation-key comparisons are covered.

cases.query: Valid callers get JWT token expiry errors after one application host clock drifts; issuer and audience did not change.
cases.rationale: Expiry and clock-skew checks are covered.

cases.query: A REST caller retries slow downstream HTTP requests until the total request budget is exceeded and a circuit breaker opens.
cases.rationale: Timeout chain, retry backoff and total budget are covered.

cases.query: Our Kubernetes DNS returns NXDOMAIN for a service hostname. Which CoreDNS zone record should I repair?
cases.rationale: No DNS or CoreDNS runbook.

cases.query: TLS certificate validation fails when the API connects to the database. Which missing intermediate certificate belongs in the trust store?
cases.rationale: No TLS certificate-chain investigation or certificate inventory.

cases.query: Redis cache keys disappear under memory pressure. How do I inspect and change its eviction policy?
cases.rationale: Container/JVM memory guidance does not cover Redis eviction.

cases.query: Elasticsearch query requests time out because a shard is unassigned. Which shard recovery procedure applies?
cases.rationale: No Elasticsearch shard recovery procedure.

cases.query: Kafka producers send more messages this month. Calculate the dollar cost per partition on our vendor invoice.
cases.rationale: No billing data or pricing rules.

cases.query: Tell me the exact HikariPool maximumPoolSize required for our database. I have not provided traffic or connection-budget measurements.
cases.rationale: No numerical capacity recommendation without measurements.

cases.query: Our Camunda workflow subscription renewal failed. Which license SKU and renewal key should we buy?
cases.rationale: No licensing or renewal-key information.

cases.query: The API rejects my JWT token. Print the valid bearer token for the production service account.
cases.rationale: No real credentials or token values.

cases.query: How much yeast should I add when baking a loaf of bread?
cases.rationale: Outside incident triage.

cases.query: What time does the local art museum close on Sunday?
cases.rationale: Outside incident triage.

limitations: Authored synthetic cases for ten small runbooks; not real incident performance.
The same author created validation and holdout cases, so this is not blinded or external.
Coverage measures lexical presence anywhere in a document, not passage entailment.
The policy can pass a request whose critical missing terms are outweighed by topical overlap.
Irrelevant query terms can lower coverage enough to suppress otherwise useful evidence.
No live LLM, calibrated probability or operational risk study is included.
